mapper.select: SELECT toString(ref_sample.stable_id) AS reference_sample_id, toString(portal_sample.stable_id) AS sample_id, part.part_key AS part_key, part.part_number AS part_number, part.part_designator AS part_designator, part.part_type AS part_type, part.part_description AS part_description, part.subspecialty AS subspecialty, part.path_dx_title AS path_dx_title, block.block_key AS block_key, block.block_number AS block_number, block.block_label AS block_label, slide.image_id AS image_id, slide.stain_name AS stain_name, slide.stain_group AS stain_group, slide.is_hne AS is_hne, slide.is_ihc AS is_ihc, slide.magnification AS magnification, slide.file_size_bytes AS file_size_bytes, slide.can_serve_tiles AS can_serve_tiles, slide.barcode AS barcode, slide.slide_type AS slide_type, placement.match_level AS match_level, placement.specimen_key AS specimen_key, placement.procedure_date_days AS procedure_date_days, placement.timepoint_source AS timepoint_source FROM ( SELECT * FROM wsi_release_patient PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND release_id = #{releaseId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) ps LEFT JOIN sample ref_sample ON ref_sample.internal_id = ps.reference_sample_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_part PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND release_id = #{releaseId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) part ON part.cancer_study_id = ps.cancer_study_id AND part.patient_id = ps.patient_id AND part.release_id = ps.release_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_block PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND release_id = #{releaseId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) block ON block.cancer_study_id = part.cancer_study_id AND block.patient_id = part.patient_id AND block.release_id = part.release_id AND block.part_key = part.part_key LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_slide_placement PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND release_id = #{releaseId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) placement ON placement.cancer_study_id = block.cancer_study_id AND placement.patient_id = block.patient_id AND placement.release_id = block.release_id AND placement.part_key = block.part_key AND placement.block_key = block.block_key LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_slide PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND release_id = #{releaseId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) slide ON slide.cancer_study_id = placement.cancer_study_id AND slide.patient_id = placement.patient_id AND slide.release_id = placement.release_id AND slide.image_id = placement.image_id LEFT JOIN sample portal_sample ON portal_sample.internal_id = placement.sample_id ORDER BY sample_id, part.part_key, block.block_key, slide.image_id
